description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing projects within the Coocook application. It includes actions for viewing, editing, creating, importing, exporting, and deleting projects, as well as handling URL routing and permission checks.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Project
classes.description: Controller class for project-related actions in the Coocook application, handling routing, permission checks, and project management functionalities.

methods.name: fallback_old_url_scheme
methods.description: Handles deprecated URL scheme fallback by redirecting to the correct project URL based on URL name or ID.

methods.name: id_only
methods.description: Shortcut for accessing a project by ID without additional URL segments, with permission checks.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures project ID and URL name, loads the project, and sets up project-related context for subsequent actions.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for project-related pages.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays project schedule and permissions, with capability checks.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Provides project editing interface, including meal and dish management, returning data as JSON.

methods.name: settings
methods.description: Displays project settings page with URLs for update, rename, visibility, and delete actions.

methods.name: exportable_projects
methods.description: Returns a list of projects that can be exported from the current project.

methods.name: get_import
methods.description: Prepares data for importing projects, including properties and import URL.

methods.name: post_import
methods.description: Handles importing data from another project, with validation and success/error messaging.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project with provided name and visibility, checking permissions and uniqueness.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the project show page.
